nodes.text_zh: "唐僧及其同伴们表现得十分出色。"

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text_en: Guanyin nodded.
nodes.text_zh: 观音点了点头。

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text_en: "Wukong especially has learned a lot during the journey. He isn't violent anymore. I believe he is now a good Buddhist."
nodes.text_zh: "悟空在旅途中学到了很多,如今已不再暴躁了。我相信他现在是一位虔诚的佛教徒。"

official_quiz.q: Which is most important from the story?
choices: The Tang Monk received the True Scriptures.
Guanyin was especially proud of Wukong.
Servants brought a meal to the travelers.
choices_zh: 观音特别为悟空感到自豪。
仆人为旅客端来了一顿饭。

official_quiz.q: Why did the Tang Monk thank his companions?
choices: for helping him reach the Western Paradise
for letting him get captured by demons
official_quiz.q_zh: 唐僧为什么要感谢他的同伴？
choices_zh: 帮助他到达西方极乐世界

official_quiz.q: How would the travelers return to the Tang Empire?
